description: Decisions on the flags scripts/data/build_sp500_full_universe.py check raises for the full S&P 500 EODHD panel (#386). Each says why the flag is not a price error.

AA.N.identity: EODHD lists AA.US as 'Alcoa Corp', the company LSEG names 'Alcoa Corp'. Its rows start 2016-11-01, with when-issued trading before its first member day 2016-11-01, so they hold no parent-company history.

extreme_moves.2020-06-04: American Airlines rose 41% on 2020-06-04 in the June 2020 airline rally; the month's share step is its June 2020 share offering, so market cap does not corroborate the day.

extreme_moves.2022-11-01: Abiomed rose 50% on the 2022-11-01 announcement that Johnson & Johnson would acquire it.
